source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check SUT time with system AC lost
1. Disable NTP function in OS
2. Adjust SUT time to match with a standard time
3. Shutdown the system and unplug all power cords
4. Idle SUT for at least 72 hours
5. Plug power cords and power on the SUT
6. Check SUT time

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. NTP should be disabled successfully
2. SUT time should be adjusted successfully
3. SUT time should be accuracy (The tolerance is within 5 secend)

original_test_intent: Verify RTC/SUT clock retention within five seconds after an orderly shutdown followed by complete physical removal of all AC feeds for at least 72 hours, then reconnection and boot with NTP still controlled.
original_method: Disable time synchronization, align system time to an authoritative reference, shut down normally, have an engineer unplug every power cord, maintain the de-energized interval, reconnect and boot, then compare the SUT clock with the same reference and restore time service.
manual_activity: The source explicitly requires an engineer to unplug and later reconnect all physical power cords. The agent can prepare, time and measure the run but cannot claim or substitute that complete AC-removal action.
required_inputs: All PSU cords, feeds, PDUs/UPS/bus-bar paths and residual-power behavior for the exact SUT
Authoritative reference clock, timezone and paired-sample uncertainty
OS time-service disable/restore commands and affected-service plan
Controlled shutdown, 72-hour timing, reconnect/power-on and OOB/boot recovery
safety_requirements: Confirm the OS is shut down and all storage writes/jobs are quiescent before unplugging.
Identify and remove every required AC feed; do not infer cord/outlet identity or substitute BMC/PDU/software power-off for physical unplugging.
Use electrical/ESD and redundant-feed procedures and preserve pre/post logs.
On abnormal boot, time or storage behavior, stop and do not automatically repeat the 72-hour AC loss.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare and verify time/reference, shutdown readiness, feed checklist and pre-loss health evidence.
Record operator-supplied disconnect/reconnect evidence and maintain the >=72-hour interval timer without claiming the physical action.
After boot, collect paired clock/reference, RTC/BMC, storage/boot and log evidence, restore sync and summarize for engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically execute complete cord removal and reconnection using the exact feed map.
Confirm the SUT is de-energized and visually document timestamps.
Review clock-retention and recovery evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its narrative correctly rejects agent AC handling but should not call the source's post-shutdown unplug an abrupt crash stimulus; it also lacks any clock measurement or time-service restoration method.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Automate only time-service control, reference sampling and post-boot evidence with OS-native validated tools. Preserve manual physical AC steps exactly.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-cord unplug/reconnect, >=72 hours, five-second tolerance and 10/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL AC ISOLATION WITH AUTOMATED TIME EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed feed checklist and timestamped photos for complete AC absence, paired reference/SUT samples before shutdown and immediately after boot, monotonic 72-hour tracking, RTC/BMC correlation and verified time-service restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact power topology, RTC implementation and selected OS.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/RTC, BIOS/BMC, OS and time-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner power-feed isolation, RTC retention and time-service procedures.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable complete-feed and measurement evidence while retaining literal physical removal.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; PDU/BMC/software alternatives are not accepted as equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Feed map, reference, sync policy and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Residual auxiliary or UPS power can invalidate an apparent AC-off interval.

project_override_considerations: This case independently requires physical all-cord removal, so it is MANUAL ONLY on its own source facts; this does not generalize ED-32 to other AC-cycle cases. A project may choose a shorter interval but may claim only that approved project plan, not the unexecuted source 72 hours.
expected_evidence: Feed map, shutdown/time-reference plan, SUT identity, maintenance/recovery and approval
Initial NTP-disabled/aligned clock and paired reference/RTC/BMC samples
Timestamped physical proof all cords were removed and reconnected with >=72-hour interval
Post-boot paired offset calculation, boot/storage/BMC/SEL health, restored sync and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The orderly shutdown, complete AC loss, 72-hour wait and time-accuracy criterion are consistent. DeepSeek's 'drops power abruptly' wording is a review error, not a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical operation and measurement goal are clear. Feed/reference/recovery details are readiness prerequisites, not permanent semantic blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep human AC boundary, correct its abrupt-loss characterization and add the missing clock evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain feed-map/time/recovery controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly distinguishes agent assistance from the unclaimable physical action and keeps the case-specific scope.

review_improvement: Corrects the fault model from abrupt AC drop to post-shutdown retention, adds proof of complete de-energization and a defensible five-second measurement.
independent_technical_reasoning: Even though time-service operations and measurement are automatable, complete removal and reconnection of every physical cord is an indispensable core stimulus. Under the locked rule, that makes the entire case MANUAL ONLY.
